# W3.1 pilot vocabulary for the knowledge-system architecture.
# D1 approved the vocabulary design; individual source-backed concepts and
# relationships remain proposed until their projection is reviewed.
version: 1
project_id: b0-f03-dev
domain: source-code knowledge systems
competency_questions:
  - Which source snapshot produced this citation and its vector chunk?
  - Which code symbol implements a requirement, and which test verifies it?
  - Is a claim supported by the same snapshot as the retrieved code?
  - Which two reviewed claims contradict each other?
  - What evidence is missing before an implementation relation can be verified?
  - Which concepts match an ambiguous Korean or English query term?
concepts:
  - id: project
    kind: entity
    definition: A named isolation boundary for source, indexes, reviews, and queries.
    includes: [Project identity, project-specific policies]
    excludes: [A Git checkout, one dataset version]
    terms: [{lang: en, value: project, preferred: true}, {lang: ko, value: 프로젝트, preferred: true}]
    status: proposed
  - id: dataset
    kind: artifact
    definition: One immutable coordinated build of graph, vector, and optional semantic projections.
    includes: [Build identity, index manifests]
    excludes: [The mutable active pointer, source repository]
    terms: [{lang: en, value: project, preferred: true}, {lang: ko, value: 프로젝트, preferred: true}]
    status: proposed
  - id: source-snapshot
    kind: artifact
    definition: A captured and identified set of source bytes and policies to which all evidence in a dataset refers.
    includes: [Committed Git source, captured working-tree source, captured non-Git source]
    excludes: [A Git commit alone when working-tree bytes differ, an uncaptured editor buffer]
    terms: [{lang: en, value: source snapshot, preferred: true}, {lang: ko, value: 소스 스냅샷, preferred: true}]
    status: proposed
  - id: source-file
    kind: artifact
    definition: A source document or code file addressed relative to one source snapshot.
    includes: [Captured code, captured Markdown]
    excludes: [Historical hunk path counted as a current file]
    terms: [{lang: en, value: source file, preferred: true}, {lang: ko, value: 소스 파일, preferred: true}]
    status: proposed
  - id: code-symbol
    kind: entity
    definition: A language parser's named code construct with a source range and stable join identity.
    includes: [Function, type, method]
    excludes: [A vector chunk without a verified AST anchor]
    terms: [{lang: en, value: code symbol, preferred: true}, {lang: ko, value: 코드 심볼, preferred: true}]
    status: proposed
  - id: vector-chunk
    kind: artifact
    definition: A bounded source span represented by an embedding and searchable metadata.
    includes: [Code chunk, document child chunk]
    excludes: [A semantic fact proven only by similarity]
    terms: [{lang: en, value: vector chunk, preferred: true}, {lang: ko, value: 벡터 청크, preferred: true}]
    status: proposed
  - id: document-section
    kind: artifact
    definition: A heading-scoped span of a source document with exact source lines.
    includes: [Markdown section, specification section]
    excludes: [A fabricated summary without source lines]
    terms: [{lang: en, value: document section, preferred: true}, {lang: ko, value: 문서 절, preferred: true}]
    status: proposed
  - id: claim
    kind: entity
    definition: A reviewable statement about the project that cites a source section.
    includes: [Proposed assertion text, reviewed statement]
    excludes: [A heading alone, ungrounded model output]
    terms: [{lang: en, value: claim, preferred: true}, {lang: ko, value: 주장, preferred: true}]
    status: proposed
  - id: evidence-span
    kind: artifact
    definition: An origin, relative path, line range, file digest, and range digest tied to one source snapshot.
    includes: [Document lines, code lines, test lines]
    excludes: [A similarity score without retrievable source]
    terms: [{lang: en, value: evidence span, preferred: true}, {lang: ko, value: 근거 범위, preferred: true}]
    status: proposed
  - id: semantic-assertion
    kind: entity
    definition: A typed and directed relationship between two identified objects with separate evidence and review state.
    includes: [SUPPORTS relation, CONTRADICTS relation]
    excludes: [An untyped graph edge treated as proven meaning]
    terms: [{lang: en, value: semantic assertion, preferred: true}, {lang: ko, value: 의미 관계, preferred: true}]
    status: proposed
  - id: concept
    kind: entity
    definition: A stable domain meaning with a definition, scope, aliases, and review status.
    includes: [Project vocabulary entry, versioned meaning]
    excludes: [One query token, an AST node type]
    terms: [{lang: en, value: concept, preferred: true}, {lang: ko, value: 개념, preferred: true}]
    status: proposed
  - id: term
    kind: artifact
    definition: A language-specific preferred or alternative expression for a concept.
    includes: [English name, Korean alias]
    excludes: [The concept's complete definition]
    terms: [{lang: en, value: term, preferred: true}, {lang: ko, value: 용어, preferred: true}]
    status: proposed
  - id: requirement
    kind: rule
    definition: A versioned statement of intended system behavior independent of implementation.
    includes: [Functional requirement, nonfunctional constraint]
    excludes: [A claim that current code already satisfies it]
    terms: [{lang: en, value: requirement, preferred: true}, {lang: ko, value: 요구사항, preferred: true}]
    status: proposed
  - id: acceptance-criterion
    kind: rule
    definition: A checkable condition for accepting one requirement at a named snapshot.
    includes: [Expected observation, threshold]
    excludes: [A test result without its execution context]
    terms: [{lang: en, value: acceptance criterion, preferred: true}, {lang: ko, value: 수용 기준, preferred: true}]
    status: proposed
  - id: test-case
    kind: artifact
    definition: A repeatable input and expected observation used to verify behavior.
    includes: [Unit test, integration scenario]
    excludes: [A successful result from an unspecified run]
    terms: [{lang: en, value: test case, preferred: true}, {lang: ko, value: 테스트 사례, preferred: true}]
    status: proposed
  - id: test-run
    kind: process
    definition: An execution of tests with recorded command, environment, source snapshot, and outcome.
    includes: [Execution metadata, pass or failure evidence]
    excludes: [A test file that has never been run]
    terms: [{lang: en, value: test run, preferred: true}, {lang: ko, value: 테스트 실행, preferred: true}]
    status: proposed
  - id: policy
    kind: rule
    definition: A versioned constraint controlling indexing, access, review, or evidence release.
    includes: [Exclusion rule, sanitization rule]
    excludes: [A retrieved passage that merely mentions a rule]
    terms: [{lang: en, value: policy, preferred: true}, {lang: ko, value: 정책, preferred: true}]
    status: proposed
  - id: evidence-pack
    kind: artifact
    definition: A bounded and sanitized CKS response containing citations, bodies, graph neighbors, and integrity metadata.
    includes: [Citations, redaction report]
    excludes: [Unreviewed semantic assertion treated as verified]
    terms: [{lang: en, value: evidence pack, preferred: true}, {lang: ko, value: 근거 묶음, preferred: true}]
    status: proposed
  - id: patch-attempt
    kind: process
    definition: An immutable attempt to apply a change from one base snapshot, producing a result snapshot and check evidence.
    includes: [Changed-file digests, base and result snapshots, check reports]
    excludes: [An unexecuted change plan, promotion of the active dataset]
    terms: [{lang: en, value: patch attempt, preferred: true}, {lang: ko, value: 변경 시도, preferred: true}]
    status: proposed
  - id: criterion-decision
    kind: process
    definition: A human decision with reasons and evidence about one acceptance criterion at a named specification version and result snapshot.
    includes: [Approval, rejection, needs-review decision, reviewer and reason]
    excludes: [A passing test alone, existence of a test link]
    terms: [{lang: en, value: criterion decision, preferred: true}, {lang: ko, value: 수용 기준 판정, preferred: true}]
    status: proposed

sources.ontology.yaml:
# W3.1 pilot vocabulary for the knowledge-system architecture.
# D1 approved the vocabulary design; individual source-backed concepts and
# relationships remain proposed until their projection is reviewed.
version: 1
project_id: b0-f03-final
domain: source-code knowledge systems
competency_questions:
  - Which source snapshot produced this citation and its vector chunk?
  - Which code symbol implements a requirement, and which test verifies it?
  - Is a claim supported by the same snapshot as the retrieved code?
  - Which two reviewed claims contradict each other?
  - What evidence is missing before an implementation relation can be verified?
  - Which concepts match an ambiguous Korean or English query term?
concepts:
  - id: project
    kind: entity
    definition: A named isolation boundary for source, indexes, reviews, and queries.
    includes: [Project identity, project-specific policies]
    excludes: [A Git checkout, one dataset version]
    terms: [{lang: en, value: project, preferred: true}, {lang: ko, value: 프로젝트, preferred: true}]
    status: proposed
  - id: dataset
    kind: artifact
    definition: One immutable coordinated build of graph, vector, and optional semantic projections.
    includes: [Build identity, index manifests]
    excludes: [The mutable active pointer, source repository]
    terms: [{lang: en, value: project, preferred: true}, {lang: ko, value: 프로젝트, preferred: true}]
    status: proposed
  - id: source-snapshot
    kind: artifact
    definition: A captured and identified set of source bytes and policies to which all evidence in a dataset refers.
    includes: [Committed Git source, captured working-tree source, captured non-Git source]
    excludes: [A Git commit alone when working-tree bytes differ, an uncaptured editor buffer]
    terms: [{lang: en, value: source snapshot, preferred: true}, {lang: ko, value: 소스 스냅샷, preferred: true}]
    status: proposed
  - id: source-file
    kind: artifact
    definition: A source document or code file addressed relative to one source snapshot.
    includes: [Captured code, captured Markdown]
    excludes: [Historical hunk path counted as a current file]
    terms: [{lang: en, value: source file, preferred: true}, {lang: ko, value: 소스 파일, preferred: true}]
    status: proposed
  - id: code-symbol
    kind: entity
    definition: A language parser's named code construct with a source range and stable join identity.
    includes: [Function, type, method]
    excludes: [A vector chunk without a verified AST anchor]
    terms: [{lang: en, value: code symbol, preferred: true}, {lang: ko, value: 코드 심볼, preferred: true}]
    status: proposed
  - id: vector-chunk
    kind: artifact
    definition: A bounded source span represented by an embedding and searchable metadata.
    includes: [Code chunk, document child chunk]
    excludes: [A semantic fact proven only by similarity]
    terms: [{lang: en, value: vector chunk, preferred: true}, {lang: ko, value: 벡터 청크, preferred: true}]
    status: proposed
  - id: document-section
    kind: artifact
    definition: A heading-scoped span of a source document with exact source lines.
    includes: [Markdown section, specification section]
    excludes: [A fabricated summary without source lines]
    terms: [{lang: en, value: document section, preferred: true}, {lang: ko, value: 문서 절, preferred: true}]
    status: proposed
  - id: claim
    kind: entity
    definition: A reviewable statement about the project that cites a source section.
    includes: [Proposed assertion text, reviewed statement]
    excludes: [A heading alone, ungrounded model output]
    terms: [{lang: en, value: claim, preferred: true}, {lang: ko, value: 주장, preferred: true}]
    status: proposed
  - id: evidence-span
    kind: artifact
    definition: An origin, relative path, line range, file digest, and range digest tied to one source snapshot.
    includes: [Document lines, code lines, test lines]
    excludes: [A similarity score without retrievable source]
    terms: [{lang: en, value: evidence span, preferred: true}, {lang: ko, value: 근거 범위, preferred: true}]
    status: proposed
  - id: semantic-assertion
    kind: entity
    definition: A typed and directed relationship between two identified objects with separate evidence and review state.
    includes: [SUPPORTS relation, CONTRADICTS relation]
    excludes: [An untyped graph edge treated as proven meaning]
    terms: [{lang: en, value: semantic assertion, preferred: true}, {lang: ko, value: 의미 관계, preferred: true}]
    status: proposed
  - id: concept
    kind: entity
    definition: A stable domain meaning with a definition, scope, aliases, and review status.
    includes: [Project vocabulary entry, versioned meaning]
    excludes: [One query token, an AST node type]
    terms: [{lang: en, value: concept, preferred: true}, {lang: ko, value: 개념, preferred: true}]
    status: proposed
  - id: term
    kind: artifact
    definition: A language-specific preferred or alternative expression for a concept.
    includes: [English name, Korean alias]
    excludes: [The concept's complete definition]
    terms: [{lang: en, value: term, preferred: true}, {lang: ko, value: 용어, preferred: true}]
    status: proposed
  - id: requirement
    kind: rule
    definition: A versioned statement of intended system behavior independent of implementation.
    includes: [Functional requirement, nonfunctional constraint]
    excludes: [A claim that current code already satisfies it]
    terms: [{lang: en, value: requirement, preferred: true}, {lang: ko, value: 요구사항, preferred: true}]
    status: proposed
  - id: acceptance-criterion
    kind: rule
    definition: A checkable condition for accepting one requirement at a named snapshot.
    includes: [Expected observation, threshold]
    excludes: [A test result without its execution context]
    terms: [{lang: en, value: acceptance criterion, preferred: true}, {lang: ko, value: 수용 기준, preferred: true}]
    status: proposed
  - id: test-case
    kind: artifact
    definition: A repeatable input and expected observation used to verify behavior.
    includes: [Unit test, integration scenario]
    excludes: [A successful result from an unspecified run]
    terms: [{lang: en, value: test case, preferred: true}, {lang: ko, value: 테스트 사례, preferred: true}]
    status: proposed
  - id: test-run
    kind: process
    definition: An execution of tests with recorded command, environment, source snapshot, and outcome.
    includes: [Execution metadata, pass or failure evidence]
    excludes: [A test file that has never been run]
    terms: [{lang: en, value: test run, preferred: true}, {lang: ko, value: 테스트 실행, preferred: true}]
    status: proposed
  - id: policy
    kind: rule
    definition: A versioned constraint controlling indexing, access, review, or evidence release.
    includes: [Exclusion rule, sanitization rule]
    excludes: [A retrieved passage that merely mentions a rule]
    terms: [{lang: en, value: policy, preferred: true}, {lang: ko, value: 정책, preferred: true}]
    status: proposed
  - id: evidence-pack
    kind: artifact
    definition: A bounded and sanitized CKS response containing citations, bodies, graph neighbors, and integrity metadata.
    includes: [Citations, redaction report]
    excludes: [Unreviewed semantic assertion treated as verified]
    terms: [{lang: en, value: evidence pack, preferred: true}, {lang: ko, value: 근거 묶음, preferred: true}]
    status: proposed
  - id: patch-attempt
    kind: process
    definition: An immutable attempt to apply a change from one base snapshot, producing a result snapshot and check evidence.
    includes: [Changed-file digests, base and result snapshots, check reports]
    excludes: [An unexecuted change plan, promotion of the active dataset]
    terms: [{lang: en, value: patch attempt, preferred: true}, {lang: ko, value: 변경 시도, preferred: true}]
    status: proposed
  - id: criterion-decision
    kind: process
    definition: A human decision with reasons and evidence about one acceptance criterion at a named specification version and result snapshot.
    includes: [Approval, rejection, needs-review decision, reviewer and reason]
    excludes: [A passing test alone, existence of a test link]
    terms: [{lang: en, value: criterion decision, preferred: true}, {lang: ko, value: 수용 기준 판정, preferred: true}]
    status: proposed
